core_obligations: Fix the given algebra isomorphism (proof lines 9498-9500): start with the isomorphism SheafHom_O(F, F) -> SheafHom_O(G, G) of O_S-algebras.

Construct the sheaf L (proof lines 9501-9504): take L inside SheafHom(F, G) generated as an O_S-module by those local isomorphisms varphi : F -> G whose conjugation action is the given isomorphism of endomorphism algebras.
Show that L is invertible (proof lines 9505-9506): a local calculation, reducing to F and G finite free over an affine S, gives that L is of rank one and locally free.

Show that the evaluation map is an isomorphism (proof lines 9507-9511): a second local calculation shows that F tensor_O_S L -> G is an isomorphism, and it induces the given isomorphism of endomorphism algebras by construction of L.
proof_roadmap: Start from the isomorphism of endomorphism algebras.
Generate L inside SheafHom(F, G) by the local isomorphisms whose conjugation realises that isomorphism.
A local calculation on an affine base with F and G free shows L is invertible.
A second local calculation shows the evaluation F tensor L -> G is an isomorphism, and the construction of L makes it induce the given isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma recovers a finite locally free sheaf from its endomorphism algebra: if SheafHom_O(F, F) and SheafHom_O(G, G) are isomorphic as O_S-algebras, then F and G differ by an invertible twist inducing that isomorphism (statement lines 9483-9495). The non-formal content is the construction: inside SheafHom(F, G) one takes the O_S-submodule L generated by the local isomorphisms whose conjugation is the given algebra isomorphism (proof lines 9501-9504), and then has to see that this L is invertible and that the evaluation F tensor L -> G is an isomorphism (proof lines 9505-9511). The author discharges both by an explicit reduction to the case of finite free modules over an affine base, where the two statements are direct matrix computations. The claim is H2: one construction plus two routine local verifications which the author delegates to the stated reduction.
